# SD18 deterministic Human Cleric level 11 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E4/E5 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Cleric
# level-1..level-10 prepared divine spell-bearing baseline
# (tests/fixtures/rules_core/pf1_human_cleric_level10_sd13_deterministic_input.txt)
# to level 11 as chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain
# derived, computed, or parity values. It preserves the accepted Human
# race-choice seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat), the deterministic
# ability/feat posture from the level-1 through level-10 fixtures, and the
# same canonical domain selections (Good, Healing), adding only the level
# bump this bounded slice needs.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Cleric burden surface: no spellbook, no
# spells prepared, no spell slots, no spell DCs, no bonus spells, no domain
# power execution beyond the flat facets already grounded at levels 1-10, no
# domain spell-list contents, and no level-12+ progression. The PF1 CRB
# Cleric class table's level-11 "Special" column reads "Channel energy 6d6"
# (verified independently against both d20pfsrd and legacy.aonprd.com), and
# 6th-level cleric spells first appear at 11th (the level-11 spells-per-day
# row gains a 6th-level column of "1"), so Channel Energy genuinely rises to
# 6d6 and the domain spell slot count genuinely rises to 6; base attack bonus
# genuinely rises to +8 (11 * 3 / 4); base saves and Touch of Good's bonus
# stay numerically unchanged from level 10 (integer-division coincidences),
# so no new pillar is grounded at level 11 — only the existing pillars are
# widened.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-cleric-level11
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:cleric:11
ability=strength:10
ability=dexterity:12
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:8
ability=wisdom:17
ability=charisma:14
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:cleric_domain:domain:good
choice=choice:cleric_domain:domain:healing
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:wisdom
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-18-core-rules-breadth/scope-draft.md
